# The directory layout of an app.json module is the URL scheme.
# The bolero command wires page packages into main.

cd shop
bolero list -f '{{join .Imports "\n"}}'
stdout 'example.com/shop/customers'
stdout 'example.com/shop/invoices'
stdout 'example.com/shop/products'
stdout 'example.com/shop/customers/notes'
stdout 'bolero/ui'
! stdout 'internal/secret'

# The source of main does not mention the page packages.
! grep customers main.go
! grep invoices main.go
! grep products main.go

bolero vet .
bolero vet ./customers ./invoices ./products ./customers/notes
bolero fmt ./...
! stdout .
bolero build -o shopbin .

-- shop/app.json --
{
  "module": "example.com/shop",
  "go": "1.26",
  "name": "Shop"
}
-- shop/main.go --
package main

import "bolero/ui"

func main() {
	ui.ListenAndServe("")
}
-- shop/customers/page.go --
package customers

import "bolero/ui"

const PageOrder = 2

func Page(c *ui.Context) ui.Page {
	return ui.Page{Title: "Customer " + c.Query().Get("id")}
}
-- shop/invoices/page.bo --
package invoices

import "bolero/ui"

func Page(c *ui.Context) ui.Page {
	return ui.Page{Title: "Invoices"}
}
-- shop/products/page.go --
package products

import "bolero/ui"

const PageTitle = "Products"

func Page(c *ui.Context) ui.Page {
	return ui.Page{Title: "Products"}
}
-- shop/customers/notes/page.go --
package notes

import "bolero/ui"

const PageTitle = "Notes"

func Page(c *ui.Context) ui.Page {
	return ui.Page{Title: "Notes"}
}
-- shop/internal/secret/page.go --
package secret

import "bolero/ui"

func Page(c *ui.Context) ui.Page {
	return ui.Page{Title: "Hidden"}
}
